newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Broadcasting initially traded at 7,550 yen.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Broadcasting initially traded at 7,550 yen.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Broadcasting System Inc, which debuted on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on Monday, were initially traded at 7,550 yen soon after the market opened on Tuesday.
As of 0010 GMT, the share price stood at 7,500 yen.
The shares were bid-only all day on Monday and were quoted at 7,550 yen at the end of the session.

After the session closed, the TSE said it would restrict trading of the firm's shares. It said it would prohibit securities firms from buying the shares for their own positions until the initial price of the issue had been set.
The bourse also said buyers would have to pay for the shares immediately on the first day they were traded.
